capabilities: add or change a banner image from a local file or clipboard URL
drag banner images to reposition and lock their position
add and remove emoji icons at the top of notes
store banner data in customizable YAML frontmatter fields
configure banner height, style, and embed behavior in settings
extras: README lists plugins known to conflict with Banners (Breadcrumbs, Obsidian Code Block Copy, Obsidian Code Block Enhancer, Embedded Note Titles). Mobile drag is marked experimental. An Unsplash API integration is only a planned future item.
intentEvidence: A banner that fades into transparency, inspired by this forum post.
problem: Obsidian notes have no built-in way to display a decorative banner image or icon at the top of a note.
summary: Plugin that adds banner images and emoji icons to the top of notes, stored via frontmatter fields.
